header.title: Portfolio capital allocation
header.subtitle: Adjust each bot's capital allocation; NAV shares are recalculated smoothly (NAV Continuous)

toast.updated: ✅ Bot [{{botId}}] capital set to {{amount}} USDT (shares recalculated)

notes.title: How capital adjustment and Binance paper trading work:
notes.nav: 1. Continuous NAV curve: when capital is added or withdrawn, the system applies ΔShares = ΔCapital / NAV and immediately recalculates free cash and shares, so NAV per unit stays strictly continuous and no fake P&L jumps appear.
notes.paper: 2. Binance paper trading: a high-fidelity order book simulator (Binance Paper Engine) is used by default with Binance standard fees (Maker 0.02% / Taker 0.04%); if a Binance API key is configured, orders go directly to the Binance Futures Testnet.
